title: AgentDoc Cloud Writeback Record
description: Immutable projection lineage for E6.5. This schema does not authorize dispatch or prove stored-record, revision or payload joins; Cloud admission verifies those independently.

subject.description: Canonical Cloud Workspace, managed-object and managed-version UUIDs. These are a narrower admissible set than portable adoc managed-subject strings; this contract does not change those portable identity types.

event_ordinal.description: Exact zero-based ordinal within the origin Workspace event log, encoded as a canonical decimal string. Never export the store-global event seq. Cloud binds Workspace, ordinal, subject and event_digest to the same retained event.

event_digest.description: Retained chained event-record digest: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 encoding of prev_digest || event_bytes. Both operands are stored text: event_bytes must serialize the exact managed-state JSON object, and prev_digest is the preceding record's sha256-prefixed digest string, or empty at genesis. This is the stored record_digest, not a hash of event_bytes alone.

connector_id.description: Cloud connector-instance UUID, not the provider label (such as github) in Source Binding.binding.connector. Cloud verifies that the bound Source Record belongs to this instance and that its provider matches the binding.

source_binding_id.description: Exported textual Source Binding ID, not the private Cloud row UUID. Resolve in the origin Workspace and named Cloud connector instance.

source_binding_digest.description: The retained Cloud source_bindings.record_digest: sha256-prefixed SHA-256 of source_bindings.record_bytes (bytea), the exact admitted UTF-8 adoc.source_binding.v0 envelope bytes. Do not reserialize JSON or hash the database row, textual binding ID, or source-revision content instead.

revision_precondition.description: Required exact observed native target revision; never an implicit current revision. Independent of the optional revision in the Source Binding envelope.

idempotency_key.description: Unique within the origin Workspace's writeback operation. Retries reuse this key and the same writeback_id and complete record; reuse with different lineage or payload is a conflict, never another effect. writeback_id identifies the immutable record; this key identifies its logical request.

payload_digest.description: SHA-256 of exact outgoing payload bytes. A lineage marker alone never establishes payload equivalence or suppresses a new observation.
